name: University of Galway
summary: West-coast university in Galway city since 1845; 50+ degree courses through CAO, and Arts, Commerce and Medicine ask for a language besides English.

ib.text: Six subjects including English; Arts, Commerce and Medicine add another language, Commerce Maths. Strictest: Engineering HL Maths 5; Medicine a language, a lab science and HPAT; Maths courses HL 5 or SL 7.

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.about: Six years of medicine, or five with two sciences at HL 5: scientific principles with clinical practice, case-based learning, simulation and placements across hospital and community settings.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in two subjects and SL 4 in English, Maths, another language and a lab science; the five-year route needs HL 5 in two sciences. HPAT-Ireland required.

needs.note: Five-year route: two of these at HL 5

programmes.selectionNote: Every CAO applicant sits HPAT-Ireland and needs at least 480 CAO points from one sitting, with the subject requirements met in that same sitting.

flagshipSource.title: Galway Medicine: Erasmus+ study abroad, simulation-based teaching and clinical placements

programmes.name: Engineering (Undenominated)
programmes.about: One shared first year across civil, mechanical, biomedical, electronic and energy engineering, then you transfer into your chosen branch. An integrated five-year BE and ME, with a paid work placement built in.
programmes.ib: HL Maths 5 (or pass Galway's Engineering Maths exam), SL 4 in English and a lab science or technology subject, and HL 5 in two subjects.

needs.note: Or pass Galway's Engineering Maths Qualifying Exam
A lab science or technology subject

programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points in strict order of merit; the Maths Qualifying Exam route is for a limited number of places and may not lead to an offer.

flagshipSource.title: Galway Engineering: accredited by Engineers Ireland, integrated BE+ME, paid work placement for all students

programmes.name: Marine Science
programmes.about: Marine biology, earth science, chemistry, physics, oceanography and statistics, with field work from year 2 and dedicated time on the national research vessel in the final year; study abroad in year 3.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in two subjects and SL 4 in English, Maths and a lab science.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points; Galway converts IB results through the CAO's comparison and points tables.

flagshipSource.title: Galway Marine Science: field work and time on the national research vessel in the final year

faculties.name: College of Arts, Social Sciences and Celtic Studies
faculties.line: Arts (850 start each year) asks HL 5 in two subjects plus English and another language; Gaeilge as a subject needs HL 5.

faculties.name: College of Business, Public Policy and Law
faculties.line: Commerce asks English, Maths and another language at SL 4 and HL 5 in two subjects; Law asks another language, not Maths.

faculties.name: College of Medicine and Health
faculties.line: Medicine needs HPAT-Ireland, 480 CAO points from one sitting, another language and a lab science.

faculties.name: College of Science and Engineering
faculties.line: Science (300 start each year) and Engineering both ask Maths and a lab science; Engineering wants HL Maths 5.

notes: Irish is part of Galway's entry rule, but you are exempt if you were born outside the Republic of Ireland or lived outside it for the three years before entry.
Medicine (GY501) runs for six years, or five if you hold H4 (IB HL 5) in two sciences; both need HPAT-Ireland and 480 points from one sitting.
To take French as a subject in Arts you need H4 in French, which is IB HL 5 on CAO's comparison table.
